title: Find where Homebrew is installed and which version it is
summary: Show the installed Homebrew version and the folder Homebrew is installed in. The folder is /opt/homebrew on Apple Silicon Macs and /usr/local on Intel Macs.

aliases.text: where is homebrew installed on mac

steps.explain: Check whether the brew program can be found and print its full path. No output means Homebrew is not installed or not on the PATH.
steps.expect: A path such as /opt/homebrew/bin/brew (Apple Silicon) or /usr/local/bin/brew (Intel). Empty output means Homebrew is not installed.

steps.explain: Print the Homebrew version numbers. Look at the first line, which starts with 'Homebrew' followed by the version.
steps.expect: A line such as 'Homebrew 4.x.x', followed by lines for Homebrew/homebrew-core and Homebrew/homebrew-cask.

steps.explain: Print the folder where Homebrew is installed. This folder is different on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
steps.expect: /opt/homebrew on Apple Silicon Macs, /usr/local on Intel Macs.

steps.explain: Print the processor type to see which of the two folders above applies. arm64 means Apple Silicon; x86_64 means Intel.
steps.expect: arm64 on Apple Silicon, x86_64 on Intel. arm64 matches /opt/homebrew; x86_64 matches /usr/local.

source.title: brew manual; card written and verified in the lnxhelp sandbox
